component.name: FLACker
component.summary: An offline home for your FLAC collection

description.p: FLACker is a native GNOME player for personal FLAC libraries. Browse original album covers, read local lyrics and listen to albums in their intended order.

ul.li: High-resolution FLAC playback and gapless queues
Adaptive artwork viewer and static embedded, TXT, LRC, SRT and VTT lyrics
Local playlists, favorites and multi-disc albums
MPRIS desktop controls and an artwork-led interface
No accounts, telemetry or network services
